title: Fish command history
whyItMatters: Fish saves every command it has seen, with timestamps, so it doubles as a record of when the person used this computer and what they ran.
source: fish shell docs, interactive use: the history file is ~/.local/share/fish/fish_history: https://fishshell.com/docs/current/interactive.html
notes: Each entry stores a command plus its timestamp. fish keeps the file in the XDG data directory, so XDG_DATA_HOME moves it.
